integrity: Mathematical proof and separately executed exact shortest-path enumeration are supplied; no fabricated authorship, external certificate, or independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The all-set and inclusion-maximal formulas are proved for the labeled simple Cartesian product of a complete graph of order at least three and a path of order at least three; no analogous claim is made for arbitrary Cartesian products. The second-player game outcome on products with bipartite factors was already proved in 2022 and is not claimed as new. Finite checks are not a substitute for the general proof. Bibliographic priority is subject to unindexed formulations.
title: General-position and maximal-set polynomials of complete-clique paths
